The '''2026 Suffolk County Council election''' is a [[local government]] election for [[Suffolk County Council]] in England, United Kingdom. It took place on 7 May 2026 as part of the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|2026 local elections]].

==Overview==
The 2026 election for new councillors for [[Suffolk County Council]] will take place on 7 May 2026 as part of the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|2026 local elections]] in the United Kingdom.<ref name="BBCNov">{{Cite web|title=Local elections 'should go ahead in May'|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy9pyd2lpp3o|website=BBC News|last=Irwin|first=Vikki|date=5 November 2025}}</ref> 

This election will be first taken after the implementation of a review by [[Local Government Boundary Commission for England]] which will reduce the number of councillors from 75 to 70.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LGBCE {{!}} Suffolk County Council {{!}} LGBCE Site|url=http://www.lgbce.org.uk/all-reviews/eastern/suffolk/suffolk-county-council|access-date=2021-05-24|website=www.lgbce.org.uk|language=en|archive-date=2021-05-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210524162903/https://www.lgbce.org.uk/all-reviews/eastern/suffolk/suffolk-county-council|url-status=dead}}</ref> All 70 councillors are elected from 69 [[Wards and electoral divisions of the United Kingdom|electoral divisions]], which return either one or two county councillors each, by [[first-past-the-post voting]].

Beccles and Kessingland is the only two-member ward, with all other wards being one-member. Voters who live in the two-member division are entitled to cast a maximum of two votes, while those living in the divisions only electing one councillor are only entitled to cast one vote.

The election was postponed from 2025 due to the [[2024–present structural changes to local government in England]].<ref name="BBCNov"/>

The government announced plans to further delay the election to 2027, following support from the Conservative administration, but reversed the decision following a legal challenge by [[Reform UK]].<ref name="bbc16feb26">{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70ne31d884o|date=16 February 2026|title=Government abandons plans to delay 30 council elections|website=BBC News}}</ref>
